messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT — Elevated 5xx rate detected for service=\"gateway\" across us-west-2. Threshold (5m avg) exceeded 3.0%. Pager sent to oncall-sre. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2026-402

jamal: oncall here, ack. I'm looking at grafana now — errors spiking since ~14:12 UTC.

sara: copying graphs — latency also creeping up, but CPU/GPU look normal. Could be connection pool exhaustion or upstream timeouts.

jamal: prometheus query I ran: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\"}[5m])) * 100`

jamal: quick log tail from gateway (filtered):
```
2026-03-14T14:11:58Z ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream_timeout=1.250s path=/v1/embeddings msg="upstream timeout"
2026-03-14T14:12:05Z ERROR request_id=abc124 conn_err=too_many_pendings path=/v1/generate msg="connection pool exhausted"
2026-03-14T14:12:12Z ERROR request_id=abc125 status=502 path=/v1/chat msg="upstream returned 502"
```

liam: saw similar earlier in staging when sampler thread count was insufficient. Two immediate mitigations we can try: 1) increase gateway connection pool and sampler concurrency 2) divert a small percentage of traffic to the fallback routing pool (older stable variant).

sara: I'm making a quick config bump on prod: increasing pool.max_pending to 200 -> 400 on one instance group, rolling update to test. Monitoring now.

ops-bot: deploy started: config-rollout/gateway-pool-increase by sara (change set 4892).

jamal: while that rolls, I'm going to open a temporary rate-limiter rule to shed heavy requests for the most error-prone endpoints (/v1/generate heavy batch use). Adding rule to reject >10 concurrent per-IP for 5m.

sara: pool increase completed on group-a, observing drop in connection errors on that group. Overall error rate still elevated but trending down from 4.8% -> 2.1% in 8 minutes.

jamal: adding a traffic-split to divert 15% to fallback-gateway-legacy. Doing canary 5% -> 15% in 3 steps.

ops-bot: traffic-split change applied by jamal. 5% -> 15% over 5m.

liam: nice. Also noticed a recent config change to upstream keepalive that may have reduced reuse; filing that as postmortem action if we confirm.

jamal: quick status update for page: current 5xx = 1.9% (5m). Latency median unchanged, p95 down a bit. Root cause hypothesis: connection pool pressure + transient upstream instability causing cascading 502s.

sara: putting a short-term circuit breaker on the heaviest upstream (model-host-03) to stop retries and favor other replicas.

ops-bot: circuit breaker triggered on model-host-03. Retries suppressed for 60s.

jamal: after circuit breaker + pool bump + traffic split, errors are at 0.7% — below alert threshold. Incident working state -> mitigated. Marking as SEV3 -> monitoring.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert resolved — threshold no longer violated for 10m. Please confirm next steps.

sara: plan for immediate follow-ups: 1) hotfix PR to make pool defaults more conservative (PR: https://git.redwood.example/r/gateway/pull/782) 2) update runbook to include traffic-split pattern and circuit-breaker thresholds 3) tune alert to add burn-rate guard and narrow scope to endpoints returning 5xx from upstreams only.

jamal: I'm going to merge the hotfix PR (small config default + add metric tags for upstream). Will watch for 10m after merge.

ops-bot: PR merged by jamal. CI passed. Deploy pipeline kicked off: build 722 -> deploy to canary.

liam: creating a Jira for the follow-ups and assigning owners: GW-1245 (hotfix postmortem & verify default pool), GW-1246 (runbook update), GW-1247 (alert tuning + dashboards).

jamal: handoff to liam for long-running follow-ups — I'm going offline for the next 2 hours. Summary for liam: mitigations applied — pool max_pending increased (group-a), 15% traffic split to fallback-gateway-legacy, circuit breaker on model-host-03. Hypothesis: pool + upstream flakiness. Current status: stable, monitoring.

liam: taking over, ack. I'll coordinate the post-incident items and keep the incident ticket updated. Assigning owners and ETA: hotfix verification 24h, runbook update 48h, alert tuning 24h.

sara: small note — re: alert tuning, add an annotation to include affected upstream hostnames so we can triage faster next time.

jamal: thanks team. Closing page for now, will re-page if we see regression. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-402 status set to MITIGATED by jamal.

liam: action items logged in Jira GW-1245, GW-1246, GW-1247. I'll follow up in product channel with customer impact summary and any affected SLA windows.

incident-bot: Thread closed. For full incident timeline and logs, see https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2026-402/timeline
